name: B10-0549/2025 (ECR) – EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament is giving its opinion, not changing any law. It welcomes United States-led peace talks on Ukraine but says the first 28-point plan needs more work to be fair and lasting. It wants Russia held responsible for the war, real security guarantees for Ukraine, its pre-2014 borders respected, and any talks to include Ukraine and the European Union. It also calls for promised weapons, including Taurus missiles, to be delivered.

- It asks for more work on the United States peace plan and real security guarantees for Ukraine.
- It calls for promised weapons, including Taurus missiles, to be sent to Ukraine.
- It says Ukraine and the European Union must be part of any peace talks.
